## Background

Collects the human demonstrations that everything downstream trains on,
using the teleop setup from [B1](../B1-oarbot-bringup-teleop/README.qmd)
on the task suite fixed in A2. Covers recording protocol (episodes per
task, variation coverage), per-episode language instruction annotation,
LeRobot dataset formatting, quality control (dropped frames, failed
demos), and the train/eval split definition. The dataset version used
by each training run is pinned in that run's experiment record.
